metadata.case_name: WONG MAN KIN v. GOLDEN WHEEL (C&HK) TRANSPORTATION CO LTD (IN LIQUIDATION)

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: light work including driving vehicles with automatic gearboxes

source: The experts agreed that the injury was a contusion injury to the back.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: degenerated L5/S1 intervertebral disc with large left postero-lateral protrusion causing severe narrowing of the lateral recess and compression of the left exiting nerve roots
source: the MRI showed a degenerated L5/S1 intervertebral disc with large left postero-lateral protrusion causing severe narrowing of the lateral recess and compression of the left exiting nerve roots.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of lumbar spine

injuries.description: lumbar spondylosis and minimal diffuse disc bulge at L4/5 level
source: The MRI also showed lumbar spondylosis and minimal diffuse disc bulge at L4/5 level.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: persistent low back pain radiating to left lower limb
40% decrease sensation over postero-lateral calf and lateral part of sole
reduced power of left hip, left knee extension, left ankle dorsiflexion and plantarflexion (assessed as Grade -5)
tenderness over lower lumbar back and left sacroliac region
reduced pace when walking upstairs; ability to walk normally on level ground but more slowly on stairs
mixed anxiety and depressive disorder (psychiatric symptoms: low mood, irritability, loss of interest, poor sleep, occasional suicidal thoughts, reduced social interaction)

losses.description: 10% impairment of the whole person (orthopaedic); residual impairment of lower back and left lower limb
could not undertake the work of a container truck driver
reduced social interaction; psychiatric symptoms aggravated by wife's attitude towards the plaintiff’s disability and further aggravated by their subsequent divorce
mixed anxiety and depressive disorder (psychiatric symptoms: low mood, irritability, loss of interest, poor sleep, occasional suicidal thoughts, reduced social interaction)
